posts.title: Gradual Dutch Auctions
posts.summary: Gradual Dutch Auctions (GDAs) are a way of efficiently selling multiple items. Like a Dutch Auction, a GDA starts prices high and adjusts lower over time, but the price jumps up every time a token is sold.

posts.title: Introducing sudoswap v2
posts.summary: sudoswap v2 is a new NFT marketplace protocol designed to support every type of token. Features include on-chain royalties for creators, custom liquidity settings, and ERC-1155 support.

posts.title: SUDO distribution
posts.summary: Outlines the distribution of SUDO, the governance token of the sudoAMM protocol. Initial supply of 60M SUDO distributed among XMON holders (41.9%), 0xmons NFT holders (1.5%), and retroactive participants.

posts.title: deep dive 1: sudoAMM vs the other AMMs they told u not to worry about
posts.summary: Comparison of sudoAMM versus other AMM protocols, focusing on sudoAMM versus constant product invariant (x*y=k) used by protocols like Bancor and Uniswap, with analysis of NFT trader preferences.
